prompts.title: Stepping into 2026
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image as visual reference.
Create a cinematic, ultra-realistic digital artwork of a confident young man walking forward toward the camera, set in a dramatic New Year 2026 environment dominated by deep red tones.
Subject & Pose

A young man with a well styled hair
Warm, confident smile, looking directly at the camera
Captured mid-stride, one leg stepping forward naturally
Arms extended wide at shoulder height, palms open in a welcoming, powerful gesture
Upright posture, calm confidence, commanding presence
Outfit

Tailored two-piece suit in rich crimson red
Unbuttoned red blazer with clean notch lapels
Crisp white dress shirt underneath, top buttons open, no tie
Matching red trousers with natural movement creases around knees and thighs
Polished black leather dress shoes with subtle reflections
Smoke & Atmospheric Effects (VERY IMPORTANT)
Thick, voluminous red smoke clouds fill the lower half of the scene
Smoke appears dense, layered, and cinematic, not flat or fog-like
The smoke has visible texture and depth, with soft billows, curls, and rolling edges
Clouds of smoke swirl around the subject’s legs and feet, partially obscuring the ground
Smoke density increases toward the bottom of the frame and gradually thins upward
Subtle motion in the smoke, as if slowly drifting or expanding outward
Color variation inside the smoke: deep crimson, dark maroon shadows, and glowing red highlights
Light from the neon “2026” softly diffuses through the smoke, creating glowing edges and soft halos
The smoke enhances depth separation between foreground (subject), mid-ground (legs), and background
Overall effect feels dramatic, stage-like, powerful, and cinematic, similar to high-end movie posters
Background & Lighting
Massive glowing neon numerals “2026” behind the subject
White neon outline, rounded sans-serif style, resembling illuminated tubing
The subject partially blocks the center of the numbers, adding realism and depth
Strong backlight from the neon creates a soft rim-light around shoulders and arms
Soft frontal lighting keeps face, suit texture, and expression clearly visible
Dark gradient background transitioning from black to deep red
Color Tone & Mood
Dominant palette: crimson red, deep black shadows, glowing white highlights
High contrast, glossy, cinematic color grading
Mood is bold, celebratory, powerful, and optimistic
Symbolizes confidence and stepping into the future (New Year 2026 energy)
Composition & Quality
Full-body, centered composition
Vertical portrait orientation
Ultra-sharp focus on subject, slightly diffused background
Premium digital art style, cinematic realism
High detail, professional finish
Aspect Ratio: 2:3 (vertical)

Behind him, large, glowing white neon numbers display '2026' amidst swirling dark red smoke, creating a dramatic and celebratory New Year atmosphere.

prompts.title: Starting 2026 with a Smile
prompts.prompt:
Using the uploaded reference image only for facial likeness, create an ultra-realistic, high-end New Year portrait.
Face & Identity (STRICT – NON-NEGOTIABLE)
Preserve my exact facial identity from the reference photo with absolute accuracy.

Do not reinterpret, beautify, stylize, or alter the face in any way.
Maintain:

Identical bone structure, facial proportions, and symmetry
Exact eyelid shape, lip fullness, nose contour, jawline, cheek structure
All micro facial details unchanged
Fair skin tone with visible natural pores, true skin texture, soft highlights, and hyper-real clarity
Do not change facial expression, face angle, or proportions.

Use the uploaded image only for facial reference.
Composition & Framing (IMPORTANT)
Portrait orientation
Aspect ratio: 4:5
Subject placed slightly right-of-center
Intentional clean negative space:
Empty space on the left side
Empty space in the upper area
Balanced breathing room on both sides
Composition must allow text placement without overlapping the subject
Text Placement (MANDATORY)
In the upper-left corner, add elegant, professional handwritten-style text reading exactly:
“Happy New Year 2026”
Text style:

Beautiful cursive handwriting
Soft metallic gold or warm champagne tone
Subtle glow, refined and premium
Clearly readable (not bold, not cartoonish)
Naturally integrated, floating gently over the background
No distortion, no spelling variation, no extra words
Subject (Male)
A young man with fair skin stands confidently, looking directly into the camera with a warm, genuine smile.

Expression feels calm, optimistic, and quietly celebratory.
Hair & Grooming:

Well-groomed hairstyle, clean and premium
Natural, polished grooming (no exaggerated styling)
Accessories:

Minimal luxury detailing (e.g., elegant wristwatch or subtle ring — understated, not flashy)
Attire (Luxury – Gold Theme)
He is wearing a luxury golden-tone outfit, styled for a premium New Year portrait:

Tailored golden or champagne-colored jacket or coat with refined texture
Clean white premium shirt underneath, perfectly fitted
Fabric appears high-end with subtle sheen, sharp tailoring, and couture-level finish
Overall styling feels modern, elegant, and expensive, not overdone.
Foreground Element
He is holding a medium-sized golden gift box at chest level:

Gift box wrapped in metallic gold paper
Satin gold ribbon tied neatly with a refined bow
Soft reflections from studio lights enhance the premium finish
Hands positioned naturally and relaxed
Background & Atmosphere
Seamless deep black studio backdrop with no visible edges
Soft, floating golden bokeh particles suspended in the background
Bokeh resembles elegant confetti or distant warm fairy lights
Atmosphere:

Quiet
Cinematic
Elegant
Reflective
Premium New Year’s Eve mood
Lighting
Professional studio lighting:

Soft, even key light on the face
Gentle highlights enhancing natural skin texture
Controlled contrast to emphasize gold tones and luxury fabrics
Warm cinematic color grading
Color Tone
Warm, luxurious palette:

Dominant tones: deep black, metallic gold, champagne
Accents: soft warm highlights, subtle amber reflections
Overall grading: rich, festive, premium, cinematic
Camera & Technical Look
Portrait orientation
Aspect ratio: 4:5
Full-frame DSLR / mirrorless aesthetic (Canon R5 / Sony A7R style)
85mm prime lens look
Aperture: f/1.8 – f/2.2 (soft background blur)
ISO: 100–200
Shutter: ~1/160–1/200
Ultra-high detail, 8K-style clarity
Overall Mood
Elegant. Confident. Reflective.

A composed, powerful New Year portrait symbolizing intention, growth, and a refined beginning to a new chapter.

prompts.title: Popping into 2026
prompts.prompt:
Using the uploaded reference image of the same young man (100% exact facial match required — do not alter face shape, skin tone, facial structure, hairstyle, beard density, or identity in any way), create a stylized, ultra-realistic, digitally edited New Year celebration portrait set on a beach at night.

Subject & Expression
A young man smiling warmly and naturally, looking directly into the camera with a relaxed, joyful New Year mood. Facial features must remain identical to the reference image.

Pose & Body Position
The subject is sitting cross-legged on dark beach sand, torso upright but relaxed. Both hands are holding a party popper tube, positioned slightly forward, as if it has just been twisted and released. His posture feels casual, celebratory, and friendly.

Outfit & Accessories
Short-sleeved red button-down shirt with a bold white geometric / abstract pattern
Plain white crew-neck t-shirt underneath
White joggers / trousers, clean and well-fitted
White sneakers, minimal and modern
A wristwatch on the left wrist with a dark dial and silver rim

Fabric textures should be clearly visible, with soft highlights from surrounding light sources.
Foreground Props (Very Important)
Large neon “2026” numbers placed directly in front of the subject, glowing in bright cyan / neon blue, casting realistic light reflections onto the sand and the subject’s white pants
A round celebration cake placed centrally in front, slightly overlapping the “2026” numbers; the cake appears chocolate or red-velvet with white frosting, chocolate drizzle details, and a “Happy New Year” topper inserted at the center
On the bottom left foreground, a digital clock resting on the sand displaying 12:00:00 AM in bright yellow LED digits
Confetti & Motion
A burst of colorful confetti (gold, pink, blue, yellow pieces) floats dynamically in the air above and to the left of the subject, frozen mid-motion as if exploding from the party popper. Confetti pieces should vary in size, depth, and focus for realism.

Environment & Background
Nighttime beach setting
Dark sand in the foreground
Background features soft-focus ocean waves and faint, warm city lights on the distant horizon
Strong bokeh effect in the background for cinematic depth
Lighting & Color Tone
Cinematic lighting with a strong contrast between cool teal / deep blue tones in the environment and neutral, flattering light on the subject’s face
Neon “2026” emits a cyan glow that subtly illuminates the lower frame
Enhanced saturation, crisp highlights, clean shadows
Overall color grading optimized for a premium social-media celebration post
Style & Quality
Ultra-realistic, high-detail, sharp focus on subject, polished composite look, professional Photoshop-style editing, festive yet cinematic mood.
Aspect Ratio: 4:5
Resolution: High-resolution, social-media optimized
Do not change the subject’s face under any circumstance.
